original_ai_output.title_zh: ECOMOG退伍军人呼吁遣返阵亡士兵遗骸并设立国家纪念碑
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 西非国家经济共同体监测组（ECOMOG）退伍军人协会向尼日利亚联邦政府呼吁，遣返在利比里亚和塞拉利昂维和行动中阵亡的尼日利亚士兵遗骸，以便按军事礼仪安葬。该协会还呼吁为无法寻回遗骸的阵亡人员设立国家纪念碑。协会代表团在阿布贾拜访国防部长穆萨时提出上述诉求，部长表示将予以关注和支持。报道称，尼日利亚在1989至1997年间向利比里亚部署了数千名士兵，并在塞拉利昂贡献了ECOMOG部队的多数兵力。

key_facts.fact: ECOMOG退伍军人协会呼吁尼日利亚政府遣返在利比里亚和塞拉利昂阵亡士兵的遗骸
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Economic Community of West African States Monitoring Group (ECOMOG) Veterans Association has appealed to the Federal Government to repatriate the remains of Nigerian soldiers killed during peacekeeping operations in Liberia and Sierra Leone

key_facts.fact: 协会还呼吁为无法寻回遗骸的阵亡人员设立国家纪念碑
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The association also called for a national memorial to honour fallen personnel whose remains cannot be recovered from the theatres of operation.

key_facts.fact: 协会代表团由退役少将Ejemai率领，在阿布贾拜访国防部长穆萨
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: a delegation of serving and retired military officers, led by retired Maj.-Gen. Ohifeme Ejemai, visited the Minister of Defence, retired Gen. Christopher Musa, in Abuja

key_facts.fact: 国防部长表示将关注并支持协会的诉求
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: He said the association’s requests, including the repatriation of fallen soldiers’ remains, establishment of a national memorial and inclusion of ECOMOG history in military training curricula, would receive the necessary attention and support.

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚在1989至1997年间向利比里亚部署了约1万至1.2万名士兵
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: later scaling up to provide about 10,000 to 12,000 soldiers out of roughly 16,000 total regional forces to Liberia between 1989 to 1997z

uncertainties: 报道为单一来源（尼日利亚通讯社），尚缺乏其他来源交叉验证
阵亡士兵遗骸能否寻回及遣返尚不确定
政府支持承诺的具体落实有待观察
